summary: acer aspire 7 gaming The Acer Aspire 7 gaming laptop is experiencing a BSOD issue during gaming sessions, particularly when running demanding games like CS2 Valorant League and Death Stranding. The problem persists even with the recent upgrade from Windows 10 to 11.
detected_fault: heat sensitivity, particularly with the SSD
suggested_solution: Consider a cooling pad or verify SSD compatibility
